recovery.manualHint: Saves this tab's current work, then reloads this page with software rendering. Your saved rendering preference is not changed.
recovery.restoring: Restoring your work into a fresh software-rendered view…
recovery.active: Software rendering is active. Your work was restored; select game files again before generating.
recovery.notReady: Recovery is not ready yet. Wait for the application to finish starting.
recovery.refusedBusy: Recovery paused: setup validation is still running. Your work is unchanged.
recovery.refusedPicker: Recovery paused: a file picker is open. Finish or cancel it first.
recovery.refusedDuplicate: Recovery is already being prepared in this tab.
recovery.refusedAlreadySoftware: Software rendering is already active in this tab for this session. Your saved preference was not changed.
recovery.captureFailed: The current work could not be captured. Nothing was reloaded and your work is unchanged.
recovery.storeFailed: The recovery checkpoint could not be saved. Nothing was reloaded and your work is unchanged.
recovery.markerFailed: The recovery launch marker could not be verified. Nothing was reloaded and your work is unchanged.
recovery.ackFailed: The recovery marker could not be acknowledged. Input remains disabled to prevent restoring stale work.
recovery.pendingMissing: The pending recovery checkpoint is missing. Nothing was restored and the existing records were kept.
recovery.pendingInvalid: The pending recovery checkpoint is invalid or unsupported. Nothing was restored and the existing records were kept.
recovery.markerInvalid: The recovery marker has an unsupported format. Startup was stopped and the existing data was kept.
recovery.budgetSpent: The one recovery launch for this tab was already used. Startup was stopped and the existing data was kept.
